castle.definition: A big old building with thick walls, made to keep people safe. Castles usually have towers and gates.
castle.example: From her window, Hà could see the castle on the hill.

psy_pressure_tactic.definition: One move made to push a decision, such as a deadline, a discount or a display of authority.
psy_pressure_tactic.example: The second call was a pressure tactic: it moved the deadline by one hour.

stem.definition: The stalk of the plant. It holds the leaves up and carries water and food.
stem.example: The stem was thicker this year than last year.
